title: Quick Fermented Croatian Turkey Neck Hash
description: A weeknight Croatian dish featuring fermented, crispy turkey neck hash, flavored with yuzu-cure and Mediterranean spices, served in a scallop shell.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together yuzu cure, honey, garlic, and red wine vinegar. Set aside.
Rinse the smoked turkey neck under cold running water, pat dry with paper towels. Cut into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, combine turkey neck pieces, yuzu cure mixture, kosher salt, black pepper, and parsley. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to the scallop shells, dividing it evenly among the four shells.
Cover the shells with plastic wrap or a damp cloth, and let them ferment at room temperature (68-72°F) for 4-6 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Place the shells on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil over the turkey neck mixture, then sprinkle with salt. Toss to coat.
Bake the shells in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the turkey neck is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the shells from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes. Serve immediately.
